entries.hypothesis: The lower-radio result selected by event 0x102f is 0x0fc3
entries.conclusion: The event branch loads 0x0fbf at 0x24788e and enters the dispatcher call at 0x246ad6 with that value intact; swap16-aware table decoding maps it to 0x245cb2 -> 0x253610

entries.hypothesis: Lower result 0x0fbf selects 0x245c76 -> 0x2525a8 -> task-10 0x1392 and completes task 17
entries.conclusion: The result table maps 0x0fbf to context handler 0x253610, 0x0fc1 to completion status 0x1391, and 0x0fc2 to radio-state status 0x1392; only the 0x1391 task-10 route can reach 0x0434

entries.hypothesis: Forcing numeric event 0x05e8 proves the organic registration predecessor
entries.conclusion: The event is a valid argumentless callback input, but forcing it bypasses the unresolved publisher activation and downstream readiness path

entries.hypothesis: A DSP type-0x80 primitive-0x70 response completes the current registration context
entries.conclusion: The real RX path delivers the fabricated primitive-0x70 payload, but task 13 rejects it across tested delays; this disproves that payload only, not the broader type-0x80 family decoded at 0x284ac4

entries.hypothesis: A valid type-0x80/type-0x83 0x040b transfer supplies the missing ordinary-registration 0x05dc/0x05e8 predecessor
entries.conclusion: Successful task-13 segmented-transfer reassembly at 0x23e62c emits task-16 status 0x05eb; callback 0x3c handles it on a dedicated branch that publishes 0x057a and returns 0x05e6, bypassing its 0x05e8 fallback and constructing no object-bearing 0x05dc lifecycle. The task-13 subsystem is not yet identified; it must not be conflated with the task-6 UI window stack

entries.hypothesis: A validated DSP RX packet family populates the task-21 0x120c/D0 object path
entries.conclusion: That path is GSM 11.14 SIM Toolkit: TERMINAL PROFILE/91xx -> 0x120c -> FETCH A0/12 -> proactive D0 command. Validated DSP RX families have no edge into this SAT chain; this does not exclude a different DSP-owned registration path

entries.hypothesis: Periodic header-only DSP RX type-0x03 liveness traffic activates the missing ordinary-registration publisher
entries.conclusion: Two independent empty-ring-gated DSP RAM/FIQ0 runs were consumed by task 4. The first incremented firmware activity counter 0x112502 but emitted none of 0x05e8, 0x05ea, 0x07dd, 0x09d8, or 0x0434. The later 182-heartbeat experiment also emitted none of callback-0x1a status 0x1400, initializer status 0x08ac, controller status 0x0795, or report code 7. A newer coherent profile reaches 0x08ac through a different controller owner; this does not change the finding that liveness traffic alone supplies no semantic completion

entries.hypothesis: The organic outbound DSP type-0x70 payload 0a 09 expects a type-0x74 echo which completes task 13 and reports startup code 7
entries.conclusion: An empty-ring-gated type-0x74 payload 0a 09 was delivered through the real DSP RX/FIQ0 path immediately after the organic request. It produced no task-13 message, 0x05eb, code 7, or mode advance; task 1 remained in mode 0x0004. This disproves that response shape, not the broader type-0x70 request family

entries.hypothesis: An ordinary DSP-downstream completion advances callback-state slot 0x45 and selects 0x09d0 as the missing report-code-7 predecessor
entries.conclusion: Runtime observes only zero writes. Static coverage comprises 46 selector-0x45 catalogue rows (all state 0x3f/preserve), all 46 generic initialization/reconciliation records (no selector 0x45), 47 exact-address literal references (one direct store, the global-0x05e2 reset at 0x299ba0), and 57 array-base literal references (broad indexed writers only clear the slot). No identified writer reaches a DSP prerequisite. The 0x09d0 path remains mapped but has no evidenced ordinary owner.

entries.hypothesis: A normal 3210 ADC value or calibration activates one of the two power-owned report-code-7 callers during ordinary boot
entries.conclusion: The 0x21e40c caller is battery event 0x25 under the firmware string 'Check voltage level for shutdown'; selector 1 value 0x1b0 powers off before task 1, while 0x1c0 reaches mode 0x0004 with battery band 2 and no code 7. The 0x21f8de caller is also confined to the low-voltage/charger lifecycle. These are shutdown/power-event reporters, not the missing ordinary-ready producer

entries.hypothesis: Callback-table index 0x1a receives an ordinary-boot callback return 0x1400 and initiates the 0x08ac to 0x0795 code-7 chain
entries.conclusion: 0x1400 is decoded from an argumentless task-5 mailbox message at 0x2af57c, not returned by a callback. All 188 direct task-5 event-helper calls have recovered constant events and none emits 0x1400; the remaining unresolved-destination sender routes through a service table that does not target task 5. The chain is a mapped dormant or service-specific contract, not the strongest ordinary-boot route

entries.hypothesis: Display statuses 0x0280, 0x0281, or 0x0282 head the ordinary-boot lifecycle that supplies global 0x05eb and report code 7
entries.conclusion: The 0x028x states are owned by the transaction engine around 0x264504/0x264c98 and reached from contact-service commands 0x81/0x82 and local/test ASCII command frontends. No catalogue or literal producer establishes an ordinary source, and coherent controller-transform tracing produces none of them. The route is valid but service/test-specific.

entries.hypothesis: Display status 0x06ca supplies ordinary report code 7 through 0x0795 while task 1 is parked in mode 0x0004
entries.conclusion: The 0x06ca case at 0x28c268 reaches the 0x0795 generator only when getter 0x2af066 returns startup/display state 7. The ordinary fallback enters mode 0x0004 after setter 0x2af058 establishes state 3; state 7 belongs a separate mode-2 branch after input code 0x10. Coherent runtime observes state 3 and no 0x06ca/0x0795 publication.

entries.hypothesis: The organically reached 0x08ac -> 0x27f150 controller route is the unconditional ordinary-boot owner of 0x0795 and task-1 report code 7
entries.conclusion: The corrected guard is 0x11fd04, but coherent service-5 initialization proves initializer 0x27f9e8 owns it from EF_ACMmax. A standards-valid exhausted account reaches 0x27f23e organically and the function publishes 0x019a, not 0x0795. The true non-display 0x0795 producer at 0x28796a is reached after 0x08b0. The variable-length catalogue proves two inputs: packed 0x213a/0x613a expands to 0x089a,0x08b0 and packed 0x213b/0x613b emits 0x08b0 directly. Status 0x013a is consumed by callback 0x24 in framework mode 11; callback 0x013b is registered only after input 0x03ab establishes the same later mode, while coherent startup remains in mode 0. The other literal producer requires display state 7. Thus 0x08ac -> 0x27f150 is not the ordinary code-7 route.

entries.hypothesis: The organic outbound DSP type-0x1a packet is a request whose direct inbound reply supplies task-17 registration completion
entries.conclusion: The sole caller of builder 0x219f0c is task-10 state dispatcher 0x21ba54; after posting the packet the builder retains no transaction token, reply object, or task-3 callback, arms only the global DSP cadence timer, clears the activity counter, and returns after task 17 has already received 0x043c. The apparent type-0x80 correlation at 0x284c74 instead tests radio-controller state 0x10dbd2, observed as 0x00 at the send, against later state 0x1a and can publish 0x1395 rather than 0x1391. Type 0x1a is a fire-and-forget state/control publication, not the missing direct registration request

entries.hypothesis: The task-21 0x120c -> A0/12 -> D0 path is the missing ordinary SIM-registration predecessor
entries.conclusion: A0/12 and D0 are the GSM 11.14 FETCH/proactive-command protocol. Firmware arms it only after TERMINAL PROFILE for phase >=3, and the profile-download function is itself downstream of the current registration wall

entries.hypothesis: Controller modes 0x11 and 0x13 select non-SAT callbacks 0x3a and 0x36 that can activate ordinary registration through 0x0578
entries.conclusion: Exhaustive concrete execution of dispatcher 0x253e20 maps mode 0x11 only from event 0x1782 and mode 0x13 only from event 0x1779; the complete mode map is sourced exclusively by the proactive-SIM 0x1770..0x1788 family

entries.hypothesis: Task-15 status 0x09ee is an independent lower-peer result which starts the callback-7 session factory
entries.conclusion: Seven branches inside task 15 construct 0x09ee through 0x208ee0; task 15 forwards its local result to task 17, which constructs 0x0a2e and returns it before the factory runs. The absent predecessor is the earlier object-bearing task-15 operation, not 0x09ee or 0x0a2e

entries.hypothesis: A valid DSP type-0x80 segmented completion correlated with the organic type-0x70 0a09 transaction supplies callback 0x5d status 0x05eb and report code 7
entries.conclusion: The packet traverses FIQ0, normalizes to 0x040b, returns parser result 0x061a, and publishes 0x05eb directly to task 16 through 0x23e1a4. It does not enter the global callback sweep, call the code-7 reporter, or advance task 1 beyond mode 0x0004

entries.hypothesis: Callback 0x47's shared 0x05e1 branch is selected by absent dynamic statuses 0x0778 and 0x1441
entries.conclusion: Correct subtract-cascade execution yields 0x0578 and 0x1440. The observed 0x05dc branch starts the generic text/UI manager through 0x24b174 -> 0x24af70, stores 0x0578 as its completion, and publishes 0x057c when presented. The coherent run reaches 0x05dc/0x057c but no interactive completion. This is not an absent DSP/network reply or the unconditional code-7 owner.

entries.hypothesis: Injected 0x1196 or replayed commit keys can establish coherent SIM registration
entries.conclusion: They reach downstream handlers without the owned reply object and never set ENABLE organically

entries.hypothesis: Task-8 0x8d/0x8e traffic is the missing generic-service peer response
entries.conclusion: No evidenced edge links this traffic to an organic 0x05e8 publisher path

entries.hypothesis: Scheduler event 0x74 producers also produce contact-service command 0x74
entries.conclusion: They are separate namespaces and transports; the command is an external request with an MCU acknowledgement

entries.hypothesis: The deep-profile command-0x64 storm is repeated watchdog result 2 or repeated consumption of the injected response allocation
entries.conclusion: The injected result-5 allocation is consumed and freed once. Firmware-generated status frames then pass through task 7 with route selector 1 and return as fresh task-2 allocations, repeatedly re-entering 0x236dc4 with result 5. The anomaly is caused by the provisional responder's incomplete transport session, not the watchdog
